title: 15.87. Saraṇaduka, Atītattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Saraṇo atīto dhammo nasaraṇassa naatītassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā tīṇi, upanissaye cattāri. (Anāgato atītasadiso.)
